The action no longer writes member_count: it inserts the active row and lets the trigger count, maps the P0001 circle_full raise on insert and on reactivation to 'This circle is full.', wakes a pending or inactive row with the same status UPDATE joinCircle uses, treats only status active as already joined, settles a 23505 insert race by reading the row, and bumps invite_links.used_count with a compare-and-set that re-reads on a lost race. The invite page selects status and sets alreadyMember only for active. Migration 20270345013000_scan_744_resync_circle_member_count.sql re-runs the section 3 resync so inflated circles are repaired.
